title: Resource Resolver: exact identity in, verified approved representation out
summary: Runtime resolution is a consumption seam beneath Resource Editor/contract publication authority. It receives an exact published ResourceRef, verifies authority/manifest/bytes, and returns only an approved representation for the renderer/delivery profile.
invariants: Resolver never publishes or edits a resource; Resource Editor/contract own publication authority.
Definition does not provide a URL/path/inline customer copy.
Exact resourceId@version/contentAddress must match authority evidence before bytes are rendered.
Delivery-profile selection may choose only an approved representation of the same exact resource.
current_scope: static or HTTP Resource Authority configured independently of ResourceRef
deliberately_not_yet_defined: TERMS/ICON/ILLUSTRATION role mappings beyond an explicit contract

provenance.claim: Earlier runtime resolver proof; consumption mechanism, not publication authority.
